what: one temperature per exit, fitted on the released weights; no cal-4b head is used (cal_mode temp)
fit: per exit L: logT_L = argmin over the grid -2..3 step .01 of the question-type-weighted NLL on half A of the policy development set v1 (rsijev/exit_policy.py fit_temperatures)
weights: w = p_EVAL(cell) / n_half(cell), cell = (mode, option-count bucket <=2 | 3-4 | 5-9 | >=10); the evaluation set's cell counts use mode and option count only, no labels (exit_policy.EVAL_CELLS)

package_chain: temperatures: calibration.json cal_mode temp, calibration.safetensors cal_logT = the main exit's DEV temperature
policy: the cascade selection's per-exit logT, meta.adaptive and the serving fields (own-token pooling, max_length 32768, train_max_length 4096)
exit 12 dropped: head removed from aux_scorers, aux_exits [16, 20]
